title: SolubleMPNN Input Parameters
description: Normalized request shape for the SolubleMPNN sequence-design adapter. SolubleMPNN is ProteinMPNN loaded with the solubility-biased checkpoint (soluble_v_48_020.pt); the wire format is identical to ProteinMPNN plus a `solubility_strictness` knob.

backbones.description: List of backbone structures to design sequences for. Typically S3 URIs resolved into /inputs/backbones/*.pdb at runtime.

seeds.description: Random seeds for sampling; one run per seed, producing num_seq_per_target sequences each.

omit_aas.description: Single-letter amino acids to exclude from designed sequences. Default 'CXHKR' avoids cysteines plus charged residues (H/K/R) that correlate with E. coli inclusion-body formation.

num_seq_per_target.description: Number of sequences to sample per backbone per seed.

solubility_strictness.description: 'default' uses the standard soluble_v_48_020 checkpoint; 'strict' keeps the default charged-residue omit list even if the user overrides it, and caps `temperature` at 0.1. Intended for high-confidence E. coli expression campaigns.

fixed_positions.description: Optional per-chain fixed residue indices (1-based). Keys are chain IDs; values are lists of residue indices whose identity should NOT be redesigned.
